name: Ceftazidime
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 1 g IV or IM every 8 to 12 hours

usual_adult_dose.indication: Serious gynecologic or intra-abdominal infection; meningitis; life-threatening infection

key_interactions.effect: Nephrotoxicity reported with cephalosporins given with these drugs (label).

serious: Seizures, nonconvulsive status epilepticus, encephalopathy in kidney impairment

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to ceftazidime or other cephalosporins
monitoring: Kidney function with aminoglycosides or loop diuretics

pk.half_life_eskd: Significantly prolonged in kidney impairment (label; no value given)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: 80% to 90% unchanged in urine over 24 hours (glomerular filtration)
